name: kol-market-chat
description: Slack-style market chat by Algostonk with predefined channels, viewer posting, ticker-first KOL context, and multilingual bot alerts: each KOL wire message gives the key point, a compact leaderboard track-record line, and a link to the original X post. Daily leaderboard watchlist, 10-minute post scanning, EN/CN/KR.

releases.changelog: Live prices on message tickers: at alert time the feed fetches latest intraday price (5-min klines; US stocks, Binance spot crypto, non-US daily) plus 24h change for each cited ticker. Push adds a compact price line; ticker pills show price and colored 24h change, hidden when unavailable.

Composer fixes: Enter sends (Shift+Enter for newline, IME-safe), visible sending/error feedback under the input, optimistic local echo of posted messages. Backfilled leaderboard credibility lines onto all 52 historical bot messages.

Fix open-at-latest scrolling (body, not html, is the scroll container), merge bot message header into the headline line, move KOL-wire badge and timestamp to the bottom source row, and make @handles clickable to x.com in message bodies, credibility lines, and ticker cards.
Replace the Algostonk Bot text avatar (AB) with the custom bot image across all agent messages.

Full-width layout (remove centered max-width side gutters) and Slack-like open-at-latest behavior: channel view anchors to the newest message on load and channel switch, with font/layout-shift re-anchoring that stops once the user scrolls up.

Redesign: light-theme layout that no longer mimics Alva's app sidebar, full scrollable channel history with bot avatars, per-alert track-record line, cleaner source links. Feed: 10-minute cadence with 24-handle batches, word-boundary push truncation, structured credibility line in alerts, deterministic fallback digest when the AI call fails.
Improve Alva-style dark sidebar readability by using token-based white text treatment for rail labels, subtitles, and channel counts.
Retheme the Slack-like channel and message UX to the Alva design system: Delight typography, Alva tokens, teal accents, neutral cards, and platform sidebar colors.
Clean up the signed-out Slack-style composer by hiding the disabled submit button and leaving a single disabled input field.
Reduce the mobile message window to two latest localized agent cards so Chinese and Korean mobile screens remain readable above the sticky composer.
Convert the Slack-style chat into a fixed viewport workspace: cap visible history to the latest consistent messages and trim the ticker rail so desktop and mobile render as an app, not a long page.
Keep mobile opening at latest messages while preventing desktop body-scroll from being driven by the taller ticker rail.
Fix fixed desktop channel rail column placement so chat and ticker rail remain visible while the page opens at the latest messages.
Make the Slack-style workspace full-bleed and keep the desktop channel rail fixed during body-level chat scrolling.
Fix initial bottom-scroll for Alva body-level scroll containers so chat opens on the latest messages with sticky composer visible.
Stabilize chat bottom-scroll after data/font layout and force composer button CJK font inheritance for localized mobile controls.
Tighten Slack-like app layout with sticky channel header and composer, compact mobile workspace rail, and bottom-scroll chat behavior while preserving Alva single-scroll lint compliance.
Fix agent message CJK rendering and localize source label in Slack-style chat UI.
Keep the Slack-like channel rail compatible with the Alva design-system button contract while preserving visible dark-sidebar channel states.
Tighten the Slack-like workspace shell: restore visible channel buttons in the dark sidebar and make the app reliably fill the viewport height.

Redesign the playbook into a Slack-like, mobile-first workspace UI with a dark channel rail, compact channel header, Slack-style message rows, app-message attachments, date dividers, and filtered historical agent rows that lack traceable X sources.
Strip source CTA boilerplate from in-page agent message text, including historical rows, while keeping only the traceable source URL at the bottom of each agent article.
Simplify in-page Algostonk Bot message cards: hide the top bot/time/badge row, remove ticker and handle tag footers, and show only the traceable source URL at the bottom of each agent article.
Simplify KOL Wire push notifications: remove tracker CTA boilerplate, make notification title empty, keep compact body text, and put only the original X post URL on the final line.
Upgrade Algostonk Bot into a KOL wire scanner: daily Top-50 leaderboard watchlist, batched 5-minute X post monitoring, post-id dedupe, and fully localized KOL spotlight metadata.
Rename KOL Wire Agent to Algostonk Bot, use Algostonk display name in UI/UDF, add push-ready notify/message sidecar, and document the strict timely KOL agent architecture.
Prevent CN/KR views from falling back to stale English-only KOL Wire Agent messages; localized channel counts now match visible messages.
Add lang query parameter support for direct EN/CN/KR rendering.
Fix Recent Tickers ordering so the newest ticker-context batch renders in source priority order.
Adds EN/CN/KR i18n, multilingual KOL Wire Agent digests, and a ticker-first Recent Tickers rail with one-sentence context from top-KOL mentions.
Fix channel rail fallback and feed row normalization for predefined owner channels.
Initial release: Slack-style market channels, feed-backed history, viewer posting UDF, and hourly KOL Wire Agent messages from the FinTwit Alpha Leaderboard.
